entries.0ca44bda1c2d7230: Power supply units for railway signaling equipment. Consolidated subsidiaries Kyosan Power Supply Co., Ltd. and Kyosan Seiki Co., Ltd. carry out contract processing of power supply units together with signal safety devices.
entries.1187a4b7f1f639cf: This business produces and sells railway signaling systems, road traffic control systems and other systems. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥79,781 million, making this the core business and accounting for most of consolidated revenue.
entries.290061cbd7319871: An electrical equipment manufacturer that makes and sells railway signaling systems, road traffic control systems, and power supply equipment for uses such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
entries.3fb265a37f7662ab: Systems that control road traffic. Mainly in major metropolitan areas, orders for traffic signal controllers and traffic signal lamps performed well.
entries.8d29085e332165a1: This business produces and sells power supply units for industrial equipment, railway signaling power supplies and other products. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥13,341 million.
entries.96814c6b1dd674fe: Signaling systems that support the safe operation of railways. During the current period, there were orders and sales for ATC wayside equipment and interlocking devices for Osaka Metro, interlocking devices for the Nagoya City Transportation Bureau, signaling equipment for India's Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor, and movable platform screen doors for domestic railway operators, among others.
entries.be48e01c34858691: Power supply units for industrial equipment
entries.c2b44b9b68d01e75: Power supply units for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, flat panel display manufacturing equipment and others. Orders for power supply units for semiconductor manufacturing equipment exceeded the previous year's level due to increased demand from a key customer.
